title: click: Bug report (issue #2745) from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is click (an open-source Python library). Bug report (issue #2745) from a user of this library:

> We load `default_map` from a config file, so every value is a string. For an option with `nargs=2` (or a tuple type), `default_map={"point": "3 4"}` doesn't work: the command fails or gets the whole string, instead of `(3, 4)`. Setting the same value through the option's environment variable works, because click splits it. A string in `default_map` should be split the same way. Values that are already a list or tuple, and values given on the command line, must keep working.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
